notes.title: Update 2024.2
notes.content:
Another update that corrects a few Game Link errors as well as adding the usual QoL improvements and fixes.

* Two additional wilderness caves in the "Pool of Radiance" (DOS) auto-tracking profile
* Correction to the name of the starting area in "Ultima II" (DOS)
* Better position display in the status bar on "Might and Magic II"'s world map

* Rewrite mouse code to allow the pointer to leave the window while still dragging a scroll bar.
* Alternate shortcuts SHIFT+DEL, CTRL+INSERT and SHIFT+INSERT for clipboard cut, copy and paste respectively in text entry boxes, including the note and text tools.
* Grid axis values can now be displayed in hexadecimal (see Setup > Grid > Axis Values)
* Donjon importer file selector now also filters for .tsv files.

 - Enjoy!

notes.title: Update 2022.5.1
notes.content:
Small bugfix update.

* Added option to export to XML/JSON whether a tile has a footprint on it.
* Show > "Terrain Layer" sub-menu wasn't correctly displaying the current mode with a tick.
* Footprints would cause custom terrain to be drawn rotated.
* Possible crash bug when a game link profile is invalid.

notes.title: Update v4.4.0_f7
notes.content:
Happy New Year! Here's a selection of fixes for v4.4.0 ...

* ADDED: Disk drive LED activity light, compatible with VIC-20 and more cores coming soon.
* FIXED: Some more PC keys not available for use by keyboard based systems.
* FIXED: A-Z jump list is now case insensitive. Fixes duplicate letter entries.
* FIXED: Minor graphical glitch when tool options panel is collapsed.
* FIXED: When on the viewport layout dialog, opening the viewport type selection popup menu then dragging the dialog now auto-closes the popup.
* ADDED: Display 'fix' version number suffix (in this case, '_f7') if we're a patch release.
* FIXED: Crash bug when starting "Forgotten Realms: Unlimited Adventures"(DOS) via Game Link. Thanks hercxena!
* FIXED: Use the default map theme for new maps and regions that are automatically created during Game Link.
* FIXED: Basic 'block' terrain style not visible on the brush overlay next to the other standard styles.
* FIXED: Corrected a minor error in the Game Link profile for "Metroid 2", thanks to Grauken for this!!

tags.feature: * ADDED: Disk drive LED activity light, compatible with VIC-20 and more cores coming soon.

tags.bug: * FIXED: Some more PC keys not available for use by keyboard based systems.
* FIXED: A-Z jump list is now case insensitive. Fixes duplicate letter entries.
* FIXED: Minor graphical glitch when tool options panel is collapsed.
* FIXED: When on the viewport layout dialog, opening the viewport type selection popup menu then dragging the dialog now auto-closes the popup.
